faqs.q: Sec. 46-38. - Removal of commissioners; authority of mayor.
faqs.a:
The mayor may remove a commissioner for inefficiency or neglect of duty or misconduct
               in office, but only after the commissioner has been given a copy of the charges, which
               may be made by the mayor against him and has had an opportunity to be heard in person
               or by counsel.
(Code 1981, § 14-8; Ord. No. 1248, § 6(1), 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-208(1).
